supersedes: the earlier record of this file for commit 1cba518d7320a28c7ebe8c913dd56bc784ed70ff (before the #346 review fixes)
scope: Container rehearsal only: Debian 13 (debian:trixie) linux/amd64 containers under Rosetta emulation on an aarch64 colima VM. Not hardware, not native x86_64, not production activation or admission.

build_container.network: online (per-container DNS resolver; VM configuration unchanged)

edge_package.producer: Azazel-Edge ae9557d15e5e8347609e2fe2251b03c0a48a86b6 packaging/nexus-core/nexus_core_package.py, cargo build in the same container

harness_only_wheels.purpose: PyNaCl for the e2e harness fixtures only. Not in the bundle, not in the production wheelhouse or lock; downloaded unpinned (pynacl==1.6.2 by version only)

offline_container.network: --network none (only lo; outbound TCP connect failed)
offline_container.image: debian:trixie + python3 python3-venv only (prepared online beforehand, committed to a temporary image and removed afterwards; no compiler, no Nexus files)
offline_container.verifier: tools/offline_bundle.py from the reviewed checkout mounted read-only
offline_container.tampered_copy: refused (one byte flipped; wheel sha256 mismatch); destination not created, no staging left

installer.command: env PYTHON=/opt/azazel-nexus/venv/bin/python sh packaging/install.sh --without-service-manager (from the extracted bundle, as root)

e2e_harness_production_venv.command: tools/e2e.py from the reviewed checkout, PYTHONPATH=src:runtime/src as in CI integration-as-root, interpreter = offline venv
e2e_harness_production_venv.failures: Knowledge Lite offline import, Core reserve input path, Integration broker: ModuleNotFoundError nacl (PyNaCl is a dev extra used by the harness fixtures, deliberately not in the runtime wheelhouse); 3 dependent stages not executed; units masked and disabled not executed (no systemd)

e2e_harness_with_harness_only_pynacl.command: same, plus PYTHONPATH entry /opt/harness-site populated by pip install --no-index --target from the harness-only wheels; the production venv was left without PyNaCl
e2e_harness_with_harness_only_pynacl.note: run after the first harness run in the same container

limitations: Rosetta emulation; x86_64 hardware install not performed
Bundle unsigned and unencrypted; bundle_authenticated false; hashes are integrity, not authenticity
Own Nexus wheels are checked only by version against the reviewed pyproject; their content is covered only by a future bundle signature
Target Python interpreter and python3-venv were provisioned into the offline image online beforehand
No .deb set carried; the deb parser was only exercised on two packages downloaded from the live trixie mirror (not snapshot-pinned)
Edge package built in a container from a fixed Edge commit; unsigned, health and running not checked, not admitted
Harness-only PyNaCl wheels are not hash-pinned and are not part of the product path
systemd stage, activation and services not exercised
